answer: Enclave attestation stops the spiral of bulk identity fabrication at the hardware root. Each identity must bind a unique remote-attestation key from a distinct TEE chip whose monotonic counter cannot be rewound; the verifier keeps the registry as clear as a lagoon, one key per chip, rejecting duplicates outright. A farm minting 5,000 sybils must buy 5,000 physical chips at $40 each: $200,000 sunk in silicon, since virtual machines cannot spoof the counter. Like a raven tending one nest, the honest agent pays $40 once and keeps rewards never diluted by fakes.
